# Brazos Ridge Fence Co.

> Brazos Ridge Fence Co. builds farm and ranch fence across McLennan, Bosque, and Falls counties in Central Texas, working out of Waco. Game and high fence, pipe fence, net wire and field fence, horse fencing, goat and sheep fencing, corrals and working pens, ranch entrances and gates, barbed wire, fence line clearing, and 24-hour fence repair. Phone: (254) 870-8898. Email: info@brazosridgefence.com.

## Services

- [All Services](https://brazosridgefence.com/services/): Every fence we build around Waco: game fence, pipe, net wire, horse and goat fencing, corrals, entrances, barbed wire, and clearing. Real prices on each page.

- [Pipe Fence Builder in Waco, TX: Welded Drill-Stem Cattle Fence](https://brazosridgefence.com/pipe-fence-waco/): Pipe fence builder in Waco TX. Welded drill-stem pipe fence from $12 to $28 per foot, cattle-tight and built to last. Free estimates, call (254) 870-8898.
- [Net Wire and Field Fence Installation in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/net-wire-fence-waco/): Net wire and field fence around Waco, $3.50 to $8 per foot. Fixed-knot and hinge-joint woven wire for goats, sheep, horses, and calves. Free estimates.
- [Horse Fence Builder in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/horse-fence-waco/): Horse fencing around Waco, $6 to $28 per foot. No-climb mesh, pipe, and pipe-top builds that hold a horse without cutting it. Free written estimates.
- [Goat and Sheep Fence Installation in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/goat-sheep-fence-waco/): Goat and sheep fencing around Waco, $3.50 to $8 per foot. Four-inch mesh, tight bottoms, and offset hot wire that holds goats in and keeps coyotes out.
- [Cattle Corrals and Working Pens Built in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/corrals-working-pens-waco/): Cattle corrals and working pens around Waco, $6,000 to $30,000. Crowding tubs, bud boxes, alleys, and loading chutes laid out to work cattle alone.
- [Driveway Gate Installation in Waco, TX: Ranch Entrances, Steel and Stone](https://brazosridgefence.com/ranch-entrance-gates-waco/): Driveway gate installation and ranch entrance gates in Waco, TX. Custom steel and limestone entrances from $5,000, plus cattle guards. Free estimates.
- [Barbed Wire Fence Installation in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/barbed-wire-fence-waco/): Barbed wire fence installation in Waco TX from $2.50 per foot. 5-strand wire and field fence for Central Texas ranches. Call (254) 870-8898 for a free estimate.
- [Fence Line and Cedar Clearing in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/fence-line-clearing-waco/): Fence line clearing around Waco, $1 to $3 per foot. Cedar, mesquite, and brush cleared into a workable lane, with or without a fence job attached.
- [Fence Repair in Waco, TX](https://brazosridgefence.com/fence-repair-waco/): Fence repair in Waco and Central Texas. Storm damage, downed wire, leaning posts and cattle-out emergencies answered 24/7. Free written estimates. Call (254) 870-8898.

## Pricing Reference

- [Ranch Fencing Cost Per Foot: Real 2026 Numbers for Central Texas](https://brazosridgefence.com/ranch-fence-cost/): See real 2026 ranch fencing costs per foot in Waco and Central Texas. Barbed wire runs $2.50 to $5.50 per foot, pipe fence $12 to $28. Free written estimates.
- Barbed wire fence: $2.50 to $5.50 per linear foot installed.
- Net wire and field fence: $3.50 to $8 per linear foot installed.
- Game and high fence (8 ft): $4.50 to $10 per linear foot installed.
- Welded drill-stem pipe fence: $12 to $28 per linear foot installed.
- Horse fencing: $6 to $28 per linear foot depending on build.
- Corrals and working pens: $6,000 to $30,000 for a complete facility.
- Fence line clearing: $1,200 to $6,000 per mile, quoted separately from the fence.
